title: Concept: Metabase console is reachable without authentication
description: Metabase reaches every configured warehouse with stored credentials and exposes public links for dashboards. An unauthenticated console means the caller can either onboard as an administrator or read any dashboard that was shared publicly by accident.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads business metrics, and on an unconfigured instance can take the administrator account before the team does.
